title: A rejected duplicate reservation cannot rewrite the original attempt
trigger: provider embedding attempt duplicate reservation rejection journal evidence cancellation custody
guidance: Mark a consumer as owning an attempt record only after its reservation succeeds. Failure or cancellation cleanup may update only that owned record. A second consumer rejected for a duplicate attempt ID must send no request and preserve the original attempt's acceptance, usage and dispatch evidence. Keep pre-dispatch admission failure distinct from uncertainty after forwarding. The accepted example is an offline in-memory host; a durable or concurrent journal requires its own atomic ownership and replay qualification.

evidence.note: The local ownership flag is set after journal Reserve succeeds; failure cleanup updates only an owned reservation. Required admission precedes forwarding.

15 packed-consumer A5 scenarios, including a second consumer over the same journal/attempt ID, passed with SDK 10.0.302. No paid provider, durable process recovery, concurrent journal, full P08 loop or installed Bridge proof.

recheck: Requalify atomic reservation ownership, error cleanup and cancellation races whenever replacing the journal, changing handler retries/redirects or introducing concurrency. This record does not establish persistent replay protection or physical-dispatch guarantees for an arbitrary production transport.
